verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a registrable Event Webhook that posts email event data to a URL you control, which covers the core outbound-callback mechanism. The pack never names delivered, bounced, or complained event types, and it says nothing about retry behavior, so key parts of the story are unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of delivered/bounced/spam-report event types, documented retry/backoff behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time reliability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can receive webhooks for delivered, bounced, and complained events with documented retry behavior, so my app reacts to email outcomes in real time

citations.quote: To have Twilio SendGrid post email event data to a URL you control, add and configure an Event Webhook.
